implementation.dispatch: Conservative immutable-input screening before bounded external permits; unchanged events stay out of the FIFO. Changed, cold, unknown or mismatched instances take the original full checks and worker path. Screening never calls a plugin or advances durable state.
implementation.checkpoint: Cache only immutable pine.strategy JSON emitted by the original recovery-range checked serializer. Full checkpoint/delta bytes, frequency, history, metadata, journal sequencing and durable-before-publish ordering remain unchanged. Native-only payloads use the original encoder.

cache_bounds.sources: Weak references; exact live identity validation; copy-on-write misses; expired identities and oversized values use checked recomputation.

recipe.storage: In-memory journal. PostgreSQL used for separate correctness/recovery tests.

semantic_validation.wire: Exact old/new full and delta JSON bytes, mixed native/Pine state, cold/warm cache, training metadata and integer-range rejection tested.
semantic_validation.recovery: Real partial fills, resting reference/amend/cancel/duplicate steps, perpetual reduce-only, hedge compensation, PostgreSQL-backed server crash/restart, fencing, rollback and recovery tested.

retained_attempts.initial_regression: Caching every small native plugin state raised journal validation cost. Final code limits cache to Pine and preserves native snapshot lifetime; initial results are retained, not pooled with final results.
retained_attempts.failure_resolution: Tuple helper fixed; optional training omission fixed with exact-wire regression; missing Python PATH and reused incompatible test database replaced by .venv plus fresh DB; corrected release binary target name. Initial pg_ctl launch wrapper retained a descendant handle; successful separate DB creation was used for all tests. On intentional shutdown the wrapper resumed and connection refusal was retained as a launch/cleanup issue.

limits: Two measured runs per final version/population; diagnostic timings include waits and nested counters must not be summed.
Per-run percentile medians are not pooled percentiles. Pine host trace overhead applies to both versions.
Queue counter populations change: old includes unchanged candidates; final worker-paired trace is the comparable active-decision queue metric.
Instant final bar backlog is endpoint dependent; it is not proof of growing backlog or long-duration catch-up.
Short in-memory tests and three bundled qualified sources do not qualify PostgreSQL capacity, arbitrary community scripts, long-duration memory or production release.
Asynchronous traces can produce different market paths at equal wall duration; fixed complete receipts establish tested trading equality separately.
Native process contamination counters are unavailable; all capacity runs were serial with no task compiler or other benchmark server running.
